svg.text: From upload to a final status. Threshold 80, single-page files up to 5 MB.
4. Human review (reviewer page, Cognito group: reviewers)
choose a file: PDF, PNG or JPG, up to 5 MB
uploads the file straight to the bucket
S3 enforces type and 1 byte to 5 MB
opens the review queue, sees the preview
and the fields, edits them if needed
Every status change writes an AuditLog entry: who, from status, to status, when.
Reviewer decisions also record reviewedBy and reviewedAt on the document.
Unexpected errors: Lambda retries twice, then the event goes to the SQS dead-letter queue.
A CloudWatch alarm fires and SNS emails the admin.
